lean.note: The correction $\mathrm{Ee}(u)$ differs from $m\ell_g\sum_t a_t$ by a controlled error. The same leading term, with a minus sign, appears when the lower bound on $\log T(u)$ is inserted into the period inequality.

lean.note: The level bound contributes $-m\ell_g\sum_t a_t$ on the period side. When the inequalities are combined, it cancels the corresponding part of $\mathrm{Ee}(u)$, leaving the error in their comparison.
